assessment: REAL RULE CREATION, VALIDATION AND FREEZING ARE BLOCKED

blockers.detail: protocol status is AWAITING_EXPERT_REVIEW with no named approver
blockers.meaning: the curation protocol has not been approved by a named scientific expert
blockers.unblocks: curated interpretations may begin under an approved protocol, and a rule may pin a protocol that was in force

blockers.detail: canonical dataset lifecycle state is BUILDING
blockers.meaning: the canonical dataset is not PUBLISHED
blockers.owner: the dataset quality and publication process (WP-07)
blockers.unblocks: a rule may pin a published dataset boundary

blockers.detail: evidence build carries QUARANTINED, LEGACY_MIGRATION, NOT_CURATED, NOT_EXECUTABLE, NOT_PUBLICATION_ELIGIBLE
blockers.meaning: the evidence build is quarantined and not eligible for publication or rule construction
blockers.owner: data acquisition and source policy review
blockers.unblocks: a rule may cite evidence from an approved build

blockers.detail: curation_role_assignments is empty by design until WP-23
blockers.meaning: no identity holds any curation or review role; the production role assignment set is empty
blockers.owner: WP-23 authentication, then whoever assigns roles
blockers.unblocks: any actor-bound operation in the rule layer

blockers.detail: 1559 legacy work items are RAW and unreviewed
blockers.meaning: every legacy-derived candidate is still RAW and unreviewed, so none is eligible to become a rule
blockers.unblocks: legacy candidates may enter curation and, once approved, become rule sources

blockers.meaning: no curation work item has reached CURATED, so there is no accepted conclusion for a rule to encode
blockers.owner: scientific curators and an independent reviewer
blockers.unblocks: a DRAFT rule may be marked CURATED

blockers.detail: no rule approval envelope exists; WP-10's production role assignment set is empty, so nobody could have signed one
blockers.meaning: no WP-10 rule approval envelope exists
blockers.owner: a curator, an independent reviewer and an approver, acting separately
blockers.unblocks: a CURATED rule may be validated

blockers.meaning: no rule has been validated, so no ruleset can have members
blockers.owner: an independent scientific reviewer or adjudicator
blockers.unblocks: a BUILDING ruleset may gain members and validate

blockers.meaning: no source policy entry has completed human review, so no source is cleared for use in an executable rule

blockers.detail: 33 legacy work items have no evidence link
blockers.meaning: some legacy work items have no evidence link, so they cannot cite evidence even if curated
blockers.owner: scientific curators selecting evidence during curation
blockers.unblocks: those items may cite evidence and become rule sources

next_required_human_actions: a named scientific expert reads and approves the curation protocol against its content hash
two named curators complete the WP-09 inter-curator exercise
a source-policy approver completes review of the source registry
the evidence build leaves quarantine through the publication gate
WP-23 provides authenticated identities so roles can be assigned
curators reach at least one CURATED interpretation with cited evidence
a curator, an independent reviewer and an approver produce a rule approval envelope
note: This is an expected governance result, not a test failure. The WP-11 machinery is implemented and verified against synthetic fixtures; what is missing is human scientific approval, which no code can supply. Nothing here may be closed by generating an approval.
